verifications.claim: Baseball umpires often work in crews of 1–6.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'A regular-season contest will have four umpires...'; R4: 'assisted by one, two, three, or five field umpires'; R7: 'single-umpire system... two-umpire system... three umpires... four-man crew... six-umpire crew'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources describe varying crew sizes from 1 (solo) to 6, directly supporting the range and 'often' qualifier.

verifications.claim: Baseball umpire crews include a plate umpire and field umpires.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'one behind home plate and one stationed near each of the other three bases'; R4: 'head umpire (also known as a plate umpire)... assisted by... field umpires'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly distinguish plate umpire from field umpires in crews.

verifications.claim: Plate umpire stands behind home plate.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'the home-plate umpire stands behind the plate'; R4: 'calling balls and strikes from behind the plate'

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'the home-plate umpire is responsible for calling balls and strikes'; R4: 'head umpire... calling balls and strikes from behind the plate'

verifications.claim: Plate umpire rules on most plays.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Each umpire makes "out" or "safe" decisions at his designated base... home-plate umpire is responsible for calling balls and strikes'
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe field umpires ruling on base plays (safe/out, fair/foul), contradicting that plate umpire rules on 'most plays'; plate primarily calls balls/strikes.

verifications.claim: Field umpires are stationed at first, second, third bases.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'one stationed near each of the other three bases'
verifications.reasoning: Directly matches standard four-umpire positioning at first, second, third bases.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Whether a batter or baserunner is safe or out... Each umpire makes "out" or "safe" decisions at his designated base'
verifications.reasoning: Field umpires explicitly handle safe/out calls on baserunners.

verifications.claim: Bureau of Labor Statistics data suggests varied income for sports officials.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R5: 'The median annual wage... was $38,820... Part-time, seasonal work is common... Schedules may vary'
verifications.reasoning: BLS provides median wage and notes part-time/seasonal nature implying variation, but does not explicitly state 'varied income'; supported indirectly.

verifications.claim: Umpire protective gear includes mask, chest protector, shin guards.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'A mask with a throat protector. An inside chest protector... Shinguards'; R3: 'wears a facemask and a heavy chest pad'
verifications.reasoning: Exactly lists the gear for plate umpires.
